intersections.note: north (50 ft) section of Barton, ends at Wade from the north
south (22-24 ft) section of Barton, offset east, starts at Wade going south

widths.note: 50' Liberty to Wade; the offset section Wade to Armory is printed 22' and 24'

alleys.note: printed 'ALLEY' (with a faint second label ending '...CKBURN'), Baymiller-Barton block, Liberty to Wade
unlabelled 10' alley, Barton-Linn block, Liberty to Wade
unlabelled E-W alley from Baymiller to Gorman; Blackford Alley ends on it at x 1327

notes: Armory Avenue printed 'ARMORY AV. (EVERETT)'. Barton is two offset sections: 50' wide Liberty-Wade (centre x ~2185) and 22-24' wide Wade-Armory (centre x 2312 at Wade, 2350 at Armory), so it has two separate T points on Wade. Blackford Alley (printed 'ALLEY' with correction 'BLACKFORD ALLEY', and 'BLACKFORD') runs from Wade south to the unnamed E-W alley. The north-half alley (x ~1494) does not line up with Blackford (x 1327). North of Liberty is Vol 3 territory; Baymiller and Linn continue north.
